title: pagination skip link to listing
name: Pagination skip link to listing — Suomi.fi
rule: Pagination: skip-link (or in-page link) back to the listing; optional page-number field when there are many pages; SR copy without odd punctuation (“Sivu 1 kautta 20”). Dual-cite USWDS/NSW pagination.
pass_when: A skip/in-page link returns to the listing; many-page sets may include a page-number field; SR text avoids odd punctuation.
fail_when: Pagination has no way back to the listing start; SR copy uses odd punctuation instead of the named pattern.
overview: Pagination includes a skip or in-page link back to the listing start.
apply_when: Paginating long listings where users return to the top of results.
not_when: Single-page lists with no pagination controls.
agent_hint: Add a skip/in-page link back to the listing; keep SR page copy free of odd punctuation.
description: Suomi.fi pagination provides a skip-link or in-page link back to the listing, may include an optional page-number field when there are many pages, and keeps screen-reader copy free of odd punctuation (for example “Sivu 1 kautta 20”). Dual-cite USWDS/NSW pagination. Pagination with no return to the listing start, or SR text that uses odd punctuation instead of the named pattern, fails.
do_not_claim: USWDS/NSW pagination as a merge that drops skip-back-to-listing.
